metadata.title: Nineties Country Portrait with Script and Sans-Serif

retrievalProfile.description: A close-up male portrait with a cool blue atmospheric wash, featuring a high-contrast yellow script signature overlapping a pink geometric sans-serif subtitle.
triggerTerms: cool blue portrait with yellow script
soft focus male close-up with vibrant typography

recipe.visualDefinition: A tight, slightly tilted close-up of a man's face immersed in a hazy blue environment. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating a dreamy atmosphere. The typography is layered in the bottom-left corner, combining a fluid, expressive yellow script for the primary name with a rigid, pink sans-serif for the secondary title, framed by a thin black line.
coreVisualRelationships: Warm skin tones contrasting against a dominant cool blue background
Fluid, organic script typography paired with rigid, geometric sans-serif
Diagonal tilt of the subject's head creating dynamic tension
Vibrant primary-colored text popping against a muted, hazy photographic backdrop
coreInvariants: Cool blue color wash across the entire background and shadows
Soft-focus lens effect with low local contrast
Bottom-left typographic cluster with overlapping elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject's face is the primary focus, filling approximately 70% of the frame, positioned slightly off-center and tilted diagonally.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes serve as the central anchor, while the bright yellow script in the bottom-left provides a secondary typographic anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye starts at the subject's eyes, follows the bridge of the nose down to the mouth, and then settles on the high-contrast text in the bottom-left corner.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal negative space, mostly occupied by the hazy blue background texture around the edges of the face.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Cool blue and cyan tones in the background and shadows.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Natural warm skin tones in the highlights of the face.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant lemon yellow for the script and bright magenta-pink for the subtitle.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: The background is low-saturation and medium-value, allowing the high-saturation, high-value text to stand out sharply.
paletteRestrictions: Stick to a triadic-adjacent scheme of blue, yellow, and pink

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: A mix of expressive brush script and geometric sans-serif.
letterConstructionRules: Script: Fluid, continuous strokes with varying thickness, mimicking a marker or brush signature.
Sans-serif: Uniform stroke weight, wide proportions, and geometric circularity.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script features long, sweeping descenders and ascenders that overlap the text below.
The sans-serif is tightly tracked and sits within a partial rectangular frame.

treatment.outline: thin black frame on three sides

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Expressive organic script contrasted with rigid industrial sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Thin black horizontal line separating the two text elements
Partial rectangular border around the subtitle

preserve: The wide tracking of the sans-serif

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the casual, handwritten energy of the primary name.
Provides the geometric, wide-set uppercase look for the subtitle.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a soft-focus, close-up portrait of a man with a slight diagonal head tilt, bathed in a hazy, atmospheric cool blue light with visible grain.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply a large yellow brush-script name in the bottom-left. Below it, add a wide-tracked magenta sans-serif title in all caps, partially enclosed by a thin black line, ensuring the script descenders overlap the pink text.

verificationChecks: Is the blue atmospheric wash consistent across the background?
Does the yellow script clearly overlap the pink sans-serif?
Is the portrait slightly tilted to create a diagonal flow?
Is the sans-serif text wide-tracked and all-caps?

adjustableVariables: Intensity of the blue color wash
mustRedesign: Avoid using the exact name or title from the original
Do not replicate specific brand logos
Ensure the man's features are generic and not a specific celebrity likeness

mustAchieve: High-contrast legibility of the yellow and pink text

postGenerationChecks: Check for the presence of the thin black framing line
Ensure the text is anchored in the bottom-left quadrant
Confirm the script feels handwritten and fluid
recipe.reuseFormula: Soft-focus blue portrait + [Yellow Script Name] over [Pink Geometric Subtitle] + [Thin Black Frame Line]
